title: I made a website for sharing working configs
body:
Hello there,

I am always afraid of installing android updates since they broke the xdrip+ app functionality a few times in the past. I made a website where we can share working/broken configurations. Let me know what you think about it! It is available under the following URLs:

https://xdrip-supported.web.app/
[https://xdrip-supported.firebaseapp.com/](https://xdrip-supported.firebaseapp.com/)

Note: this project is work in progress, when you have suggestions on how I could improve something, please let me know

Edit added TODOs:
- add smart watch section
- implement a better table, so it is more usable on smartphones
- allow sharing the huge amount of all the xdrip settings (e.g. bluetooth) somehow
- allow sharing xdrip settings through the app somehow. maybe by uploading the xml settings file
- add sharethis buttons
- create pull request for adding this to docs somewhere
- create git repo and publish source code

comments.body: Also, I will make it open-source and accept feature requests if it benefits people. xDrip is a daily helper for me for me for many years, I would love to help out this way.

I think this is great initiative.
Many times people ask what phone is supported.
I think that having a place to show what BT settings were used will be very helpful.

And, if all goes well, adding an option to smart watches will be great.

Thank you for your contribution.
